prose: The Wall Street Journal profile, as relayed by Techmeme, describes Huang's reported resignation as the end of a 33-year tenure that transformed Nvidia from a graphics-chip company into an AI supplier. The original text was not retrievable, so this summary is limited to the feed's account of the career retrospective.
highlights: Profile tracks the shift from graphics to AI
basis: Techmeme headline and excerpt; Wall Street Journal fetch failed.
